If I had to start investing from zero, I'd avoid these 3 mistakes first 👇

1️⃣ Investing money you'll need soon → build a safety fund first
2️⃣ Putting everything in one stock → spread the risk
3️⃣ Panic selling on a red day → make a plan before you buy

₹12,000: invest it all at once, or ₹4,000 a month for 3 months? 🤔

Lump sum at ₹100 → 120 units
SIP when the price goes ₹100 → ₹80 → ₹100 → 40 + 50 + 40 = 130 units
SIP when the price goes ₹100 → ₹120 → ₹150 → 40 + 33.3 + 26.7 = 100 units

That's rupee cost averaging: dips help a SIP, steady rises help a lump sum. Neither is always better.

India apna 85% se zyada crude oil import karta hai 🛢️ Isliye tel ka daam aapke stocks ko hilata hai.

• Crude mehnga → import bill ↑ → zyada dollar chahiye
• Rupee kamzor → imports mehnge, inflation ka risk
• Airlines, paints, oil companies: laagat crude se judi
• Crude sasta → inhi sectors ki laagat kam ho sakti hai

Par stocks sirf tel se nahi chalte: earnings, interest rates aur global mood bhi matter karte hain.

Bada loss wapas laana itna mushkil kyun hai? 📉

−10% → +11.1% chahiye
−25% → +33.3%
−50% → +100%
−75% → +300%
−90% → +900%

Formula: loss ÷ (100 − loss). Isliye pehle downside protect karo.

Aapne stock ₹100 par khareeda. Galat nikla, to exit kahan karoge? 🤔

Yahi hai stop-loss: ek exit price jo aap kharidne se PEHLE tay karte ho.

• Stop ₹95 → risk ₹5 per share = 5%
• Bina stop: ₹100 → ₹70 = −30%
• ₹70 se ₹100 wapas aane ke liye ~43% gain chahiye

Pehle exit, phir entry.

Aap stop-loss use karte ho? Comment karo 👇 Aur follow karo.

Agar main zero se trading shuru karta, to pehle ye 3 rules set karta 👇

1️⃣ Paper trade pehle: asli paisa lagaye bina practice
2️⃣ Har trade mein chhota, fixed risk: ₹50,000 ka 1% = ₹500. 5 galat trades ke baad bhi ₹47,500 bache
3️⃣ Trade journal: kyun liya, kahan exit, kya seekha

Ye candle padh sakte ho? 3 second ⏱️

• Body = open se close
• Green: price open se UPAR band hua (₹100 → ₹110)
• Red: open se NEECHE band hua
• Upar ki wick = high, neeche ki wick = low
• Bahut saari candles saath = trend
